source_text: Dominus cum Ioseph; omnia prospere. Tentatio dominae — fugit, pallium relinquit. Castitas sapientiae.
pass_a_gloss: Lord with Joseph; all things prosperously. Temptation of-mistress — he-flees, cloak leaves. Chastity of-wisdom.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord was with Joseph; all prospered >> Bible:Genesis 39:2-3]]. The mistress’s temptation — [[he flees, leaving the cloak >> Bible:Genesis 39:12]]. Chastity of wisdom.
